name: Anaconda Poker
summary: A seven-card poker variant where players repeatedly pass cards to neighbors before betting.
rules_text: Each player is dealt seven cards face down. Players examine their hands and simultaneously pass any three cards to the left neighbor. There is a betting round. Then each player simultaneously passes two cards to the right neighbor, followed by a second betting round. Then each player simultaneously passes one card to the left neighbor, followed by a final betting round. After betting, remaining players showdown. Each player makes the best five-card poker hand from their seven cards. Standard poker hand rankings apply, with five-of-a-kind possible if jokers are used as wild cards. Highest hand wins the pot. If using jokers, they are wild.
